card.name: Words leading into a time duration
card.fires_on: Words just before a number of hours, days or years, such as 'from', 'than', 'time', or the first digit of '48'. It also fires on the space before a number in a time span.

modes.label: Before hours
modes.description: The word or digit right before a count of hours in a time limit.
modes.example: unless hemodialysis is instituted within 4<<8>> hours.

modes.label: Time span lead-in
modes.description: A small word like 'from' or 'than' that introduces how long a period lasts.

modes.label: Space before number
modes.description: The gap before a year or number of days.
modes.example: for at least<< >>30 days after the last dose.
